data.why: The repo ships example-dataset/pbmc3k.h5ad, the exact file the README and CLI help both use to demonstrate cellxgene; it is small, pre-formatted (embeddings, louvain clusters, QC metrics in obs) and needs no synthetic substitute.

goals: visualize the UMAP/t-SNE embedding of single cells and see how they cluster
color cells by categorical metadata (e.g. louvain cluster, cell type) and by continuous metadata (e.g. n_genes, percent_mito)
color cells by expression of a chosen gene to see which populations express it
select a subpopulation of cells by lasso/box on the embedding or by category filter
run on-demand differential expression between two selected cell populations and inspect the resulting gene list
create and save a cell-type annotation label for a selected population

review.summary: The tree follows cellxgene's stated workflow well: view the embedding, colour it, select cells by category or histogram, compare two groups with on-demand DE, and save cell-type labels. Its labels are well split between general and specific wording, and the screens support every node I checked. It needs fixes before filing: phase 1 is setup, not science; t11 depends on a later task; lasso selection is missing, as is the fact that a new label assignment overwrote 9 earlier labels; several tasks carry off-task actions; and the annotation tasks still need a replay.
